applies_to: per-site coverage required before a site can be scored in inStrain profile
source: manuscript Methods / Supplementary Note 6.1 ("Reads were mapped to dereplicated GVMAGs with BWA-MEM and processed with inStrain using a minimum site coverage of 10x and minor-allele-frequency threshold of 0.05")
evidence: baked into the values in the supplied *_gene_info.tsv files; not re-applied here

applies_to: within-sample allele frequency required for a site to be called a variant (SNV)
evidence: every counted SNV_*_count therefore has within-sample frequency >= 5%
note: inStrain --min_freq equivalent; no per-variant allele frequencies are exported in gene_info.tsv, so this threshold cannot be re-derived from the file and is carried over from the run settings

evidence: of 6,458 mapped observations with SNV_count >= 1, exactly 5,550 carry pNpS_variants and exactly 908 have SNV_S_count = 0
note: a gene with no synonymous variant has no pS denominator, so inStrain leaves pNpS_variants blank; such rows are DEFINEDNESS failures, not zeros, and are excluded

evidence: pNpS_variants == 0 in exactly the 2,005 observations where SNV_N_count == 0 (0 violations)
note: zero means "synonymous variants but no nonsynonymous variant", which is a real and informative low pN/pS

evidence: pNpS_variants exceeds 1 in 138 of 5551 defined observations
note: pN/pS > 1 is compatible with relaxed purifying selection or positive selection; it is NOT by itself evidence of adaptation (per SI Note 6.2)

source: this build; the stated 10x rule is a per-SITE inStrain setting, so applying it to the gene MEAN is a stricter, additional filter
note: reported as the conservative subset: 1,087 observations, 497 genes, 130 genomes, 64 samples
